vocal tract and orafacial motions are strongly related to each other, and both have a strong in uence on the speech acoustical signal.

the development of a dynamical model of the speech production system, where orofacial and vocal tract motion are modeled as functions of the activity of the speech muscles.
the development of a unified dynamical model of the speech production system.

the vocal tract is a major contributor to the orofacial motion during the production of speech.

the speech acoustical signal is strongly related to both the vocal tract and the orofacial motions.

vocal tract and orafacial motions are strongly coupled and that vocal tract motion is more predictable from the observed facial motion than the opposite.
